Hero.title: Welcome to ITZuun
Hero.subtitle: The premier IT freelance marketplace in Mongolia.

Home.landingTitle: ITZuun — Mongolia’s platform for websites, design, and IT services
Home.landingSubtitle: A simple platform for small businesses, teams, and individuals to order website, design, document, and IT support work in one place.
Home.floatingCardText: Payment is arranged by contacting an admin
Home.categorySectionTitle: Website, design, document, and IT support categories
Home.processTitle: Post an order. Connect with the right person. Get the work done.
Home.processSubtitle: In the MVP, after you post an order, scope, timing, and payment are arranged manually by contacting an admin.
Home.stepText1: Describe your website, design, document, or support task with budget and timeline.
Home.stepText2: Clarify requirements with the admin and provider, then confirm the scope.
Home.stepText3: Instead of automatic QPay/escrow, payment is handled by contacting an admin.
Home.trustTitle: During MVP, payment is safely arranged by contacting an admin.
Home.trustSubtitle: Automatic QPay/escrow protection is not active in ITZuun’s first MVP. Payment, confirmation, and next steps for each order are coordinated directly with an admin.
Home.trustPoint1: After an order is posted, an admin clarifies payment details
Home.trustPoint2: Scope, price, and timeline are confirmed manually
Home.trustPoint3: Automatic QPay/escrow flow will be added in a later version
Home.finalTitle: Order your website, design, document, or IT support task today.
Home.finalSubtitle: Choose the work type and describe your request. An ITZuun admin will clarify the next step.
Home.footerIntro: A Mongolian platform for ordering website, design, document, and IT support services.
Home.w1Text: Clients post projects, verified freelancers submit proposals.
Home.w2Text: During MVP, payment is not automatic escrow; it is handled by contacting an admin.
Home.w3Text: After scope is confirmed, track delivery and receive the completed work.
Home.f1Text: Work with vetted developers, designers, and QA engineers for production-ready delivery.
Home.f2Text: QPay/escrow is not automatic yet; payment is arranged by contacting an admin.
Home.f3Text: Track proposals, project updates, and communication in a single clean workflow.
Home.ctaSubtitle: Post website, design, document, and support work easily.
Home.categorySectionSubtitle: Choose the type of work, describe scope, timeline, and budget, then an admin clarifies the provider and payment next steps during MVP.
Home.categoryDescription1: Business profile sites, service pages, responsive layout, and basic SEO setup.
Home.categoryDescription2: Conversion-focused single pages for a product, event, campaign, or offer.
Home.categoryDescription3: Posters and social visuals for Facebook, Instagram, ads, and announcements.
Home.categoryDescription4: Brand marks, simple logo directions, and starter assets for social profiles.
Home.categoryDescription5: Clean up Word, PDF, proposals, presentations, and contract layouts.
Home.categoryDescription6: Prepare CVs, cover letters, official letters, and application documents.
Home.categoryDescription7: Customize ready-made templates, themes, Notion, Canva, or Figma layouts.
Home.categoryDescription8: Computer help, software install, account setup, and workflow troubleshooting.
Home.servicesTitle: 5 starter services customers can order now
Home.servicesSubtitle: These cards make the MVP offer concrete so visitors quickly understand what they can request.
Home.serviceDescription1: A mobile-friendly profile site with service, pricing, and contact sections.
Home.serviceDescription2: A single page for campaigns, events, or new offers that need inquiries.
Home.serviceDescription3: 3–5 visual directions for Facebook or Instagram posts, stories, and ads.
Home.serviceDescription4: Fix formatting, spacing, and hierarchy in CVs, PDFs, proposals, and letters.
Home.serviceDescription5: Help with software installs, email/account setup, and error troubleshooting.
Home.adminCardTitle: Payment is currently confirmed by contacting an admin
Home.adminCardText: Submit your order details and we will get in touch. We will clarify scope, price, and next steps.
